# cloady_domain (Resource)

Manages a custom domain for an app instance. Configure its DNS separately. Domain routing is reconciled automatically by Cloady.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloady_domain" "api" {
  workspace  = cloady_workspace.acme.slug
  app        = cloady_app.api.slug
  region     = cloady_app.api.region
  host       = "api.acme.com"
  is_primary = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) App slug.
- `host` (String) Lowercase hostname, such as api.example.com. Changes require replacement.
- `region` (String) Region ID of the app instance.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace slug.

### Optional

- `environment` (String) App environment: production, preview, or development. Defaults to production.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary domain. Defaults to false. Changes require replacement.
- `port` (Number) Optional application port (1–65535). Omit to use Cloady's default routing. Changes require replacement.
- `redirect_to` (String) Optional lowercase target hostname. Omit to remove an existing redirect.

### Read-Only

- `domain_id` (String) Domain UUID returned by the API.
- `id` (String) Import identity: workspace/app/environment/region/domain_id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# workspace/app/environment/region/domain-uuid
terraform import cloady_domain.api acme/api/production/eu1/9f1c2d34-5678-4abc-9def-0123456789ab
```
